Definition: properly, dawn (as the break of day); generally, morning
BiblicalUsage: 1) morning, break of day; 1a) morning; 1a1) of end of night; 1a2) of coming of daylight; 1a3) of coming of sunrise; 1a4) of beginning of day; 1a5) of bright joy after night of distress (fig.); 1b) morrow, next day, next morning
